items.title: Claude Mythos 5 designs quantum circuits up to ~39× cheaper than published baselines
items.summary: Anthropic 研究顯示，畀 Claude Mythos 5 純文字規格同自動評分器後，佢喺化學、優化、物理模擬、數論等八項量子電路設計任務上多數擊敗已發表最佳方案；其中橢圓曲線點加嘅可逆 divsteps 設計相對最小先前方案門數約少 17 倍，Reed–Solomon 解碼器最貴步驟約平約 12 倍，最大資源成本改善約 39 倍，惟結果仍屬模擬、未喺真機跑過。
items.note: article:published_time 2026-10-16T17:29:00.000Z → 2026-10-17T01:29:00+08:00. Page dated Oct 16, 2026. Benchmarks are Anthropic-reported; circuits not run on quantum hardware.

items.summary: SNK《FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves》將於 10 月 22 日數位登陸 Switch 2：標準版 $19.99、含 Season Pass 1–3 嘅 Starter Edition $29.99，預購送不知火舞 Classic 服裝；同期有東京復仇者 DLC 角色。
items.note: Original Gematsu Sep 9; reconfirmed in Oct 18 weekly list and Nintendo eShop (Releases 10/22/26). Prices from SNK US press. publishedAt from Sep 9 10:36 AM EDT.
items.imageAlt: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Tokyo Revengers DLC key art

items.title: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced Switch 2 Edition launches October 22
items.summary: Inti Creates《Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition》將於 10 月 22 日發售（$49.99），含三作＋DLC 同新故事模式 Gunvolt GX；原版 Switch 可用 $10 Upgrade Pack 升級。
items.note: Original Gematsu Jun 23 11:29 PM EDT; listed as launching digitally worldwide in Gematsu weekly Oct 18. official gunvolt.com also tracks Switch 2 Edition.
items.imageAlt: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced Switch 2 Edition key art

items.title: PS5X research emulator boots a few PS5 games on Xbox Series X Developer Mode
items.summary: Engadget 報道開發者將開源 KytyPS5 移植為 PS5X，喺 Xbox Series X 開發者模式跑起 Quake II、GEX Trilogy 等少數 PS5 版遊戲；受 Dev Mode 約 5GB 記憶體上限限制，未有公開下載，亦未見跑通獨佔大作。
items.note: Research/homebrew only; Microsoft retail mode blocks emulators. YouTube demo dated Sept 8; Engadget coverage Oct 18.
items.imageAlt: Engadget article hero for PS5X on Xbox Series X

items.title: Shrek 2 Remastered Xbox Store page leaks Aspyr remaster with photo and cheat modes
items.summary: Polygon 報道 Xbox.com 商店頁曾曝光 Aspyr 開發嘅《Shrek 2 Remastered》，並洩漏預告；聲稱會為原 Xbox／PS2／GameCube 版做畫面升級，加入 photo mode 同 cheat mode，但未公布發售日，頁面其後已刪。
items.note: Leak via Xbox Store / GameSpot spotting Oct 16; Polygon feature Oct 18. No official announcement or release window. Steam achievements leak earlier in Sept.
items.imageAlt: Shrek 2 film still used in Polygon remaster leak coverage

items.title: Insider claims PlayStation 6 RAM and NAND alone may exceed $680 per console
items.summary: VGC 引述硬件知情人士 KeplerL2：PS6 單計 RAM＋NAND 成本或逾 680 美元，反映 AI 數據中心帶動記憶體漲價；分析指次世代主機零售價討論已上望千美元級，Xbox 亦警告 Helix 受記憶體成本影響。
items.note: Unverified NeoGAF/insider claim; not an official Sony figure.
items.imageAlt: PlayStation anniversary consoles used as VGC article image

items.title: Digital Foundry sees no QSSR in GTA 6 launch trailer captured on PS5
items.summary: Push Square 引述 Digital Foundry：本週 GTA 6 發布預告（標明喺 PS5 擷取）睇唔到 Sony 新推嘅 base PS5 QSSR 升頻痕跡；分析指若內部已接近 1440p，再耗預算跑 QSSR 未必划算，最終版或會改。
items.note: Tech analysis of trailer footage only—not a Rockstar/Sony confirmation. QSSR currently named in Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei first-party titles.
items.imageAlt: Push Square GTA 6 QSSR analysis thumbnail

items.title: BeamNG.drive launches on PS5 in Early Access October 19
items.summary: 柔軟車體物理模擬《BeamNG.drive》將喺 10 月 19 日以 Early Access 登陸 PS5，同日 PC 約對應 0.40 更新；官方指開售時唔支援 VR 同 mods，並有本地分割畫面同 FSR 3／PS5 Pro PSSR 等強化。
items.note: Push Square roundup published Sat Oct 17 19:00 UTC; BeamNG official date post is Sept 24 (beamng.com). Gematsu Oct 18 weekly JP releases also lists BeamNG.drive EA (PS5).
items.imageAlt: Push Square PS5 games coming next week artwork

items.title: Mycopunk hits PS5 October 20 as a day-one PlayStation Plus Game Catalog title
items.summary: 真菌題材四人合作槍械《Mycopunk》將喺 10 月 20 日登陸 PS5，並即日加入 PS Plus Extra／Premium Game Catalog；同日目錄亦有《Mafia: The Old Country》、《Horizon Forbidden West》等，Premium 另加《Dino Crisis 2》試玩等。
items.note: Push Square Oct 17 next-week list includes Mycopunk (20th). Day-one PS Plus Extra/Premium catalog confirmed by PlayStation Blog Oct 14: https://blog.playstation.com/2026/10/14/playstation-plus-game-catalog-for-october-mafia-the-old-country-horizon-forbidden-west-mycopunk-and-more/
items.imageAlt: Push Square PS5 and PS Plus games coming next week artwork

items.title: Bloober Team CEO: studio wants physical retail versions 'for as long as possible'
items.summary: GamesRadar 訪問中，Silent Hill 2 Remake 開發商 Bloober Team CEO Piotr Babieno 表示只要做得到，就想繼續推出實體零售版，強調收藏帶來嘅情感連結；並談及 Switch 2 獨佔《Onyx》等「觸感」向恐怖體驗。
items.imageAlt: Broken Mirror / Bloober horror game imagery from GamesRadar interview

items.title: Drunken Goddess Reflux cancels Steam Next Fest demo over AI clone fears
items.summary: Alliance Arts／Who You 喺 Steam Next Fest（10 月 19–26）開幕前夕取消《Drunken Goddess Reflux》公開試玩，指難以監管影片／串流限制，並擔心生成式 AI 會快速複製 demo；改為 Discord 抽選封閉試玩，遊戲暫定 12 月 8 日發售。
items.imageAlt: Drunken Goddess Reflux drinking-game screenshot

items.title: Epic CEO Tim Sweeney says AI will usher in a 'golden age of gaming'
items.summary: Polygon 報道 Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney 繼續為 AI 開發辯護，聲稱過去一年 AI 寫碼質素大升，可令大型遊戲用更少資源製作；同時傳 Epic 重組以「最大 AI 加速」，新 launcher 被指 vibe coding，社群爭議持續。
items.note: Opinion/advocacy coverage of Sweeney statements and related Epic AI reports.
items.imageAlt: Fortnite / UEFN imagery accompanying Polygon Sweeney AI story

items.title: The Game Awards 2026 jury: US media seats fall to 17, tying the UK
items.summary: Polygon 分析 TGA 2026 評審團：美國媒體席位大減至 17，與英國首次打和；巴西升至 14，拉美約佔 21%。文中亦確認 GTA 6 趕及本屆資格截止，並指出近年 GOTY 較少由美國作品奪得。
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto 6 imagery used in Polygon Game Awards jury analysis

items.title: Xbox posts Games Supply Strategist role focused on physical game launches
items.summary: Windows Central 報道 Microsoft 招聘 Xbox Games Supply Strategist，職責包括協調實體 Xbox 遊戲全球供應、庫存同零售渠道；外界解讀為喺 Sony 淡出光碟之際，Xbox 仍打算繼續實體發行，但 Helix 是否繼續用碟未獲官方證實。
items.note: Job listing fact confirmed in article; next-gen disc/cartridge speculation remains unconfirmed.
items.imageAlt: Windows Central physical Xbox games / disc discussion image

items.title: Ghostwire: Tokyo joins GOG Preservation Program without Bethesda.NET login
items.summary: PC Gamer 報道 Tango《Ghostwire: Tokyo》登陸 GOG 並加入 Preservation Program：移除 Bethesda.NET 登入，相關登入獎勵改為首次啟動自動解鎖，GOG 承諾跟進日後系統相容；同批亦有《Oblivion》保存計劃更新。
items.note: GOG press/news also covers Oblivion GOTY Deluxe preservation update (~Oct 15–16).
items.imageAlt: Ghostwire Tokyo screenshot from PC Gamer coverage
